message: What if the item I ordered is out of stock?
reply_text: If an item you ordered is out of stock, we’ll notify you and give you a few options: we can place the item on backorder and ship it when it becomes available, cancel the out-of-stock item and issue a refund to your original payment method, or (with your approval) offer a substitution or store credit. You’ll be informed of the out-of-stock status and any estimated timing for restock; if a backorder or substitution is selected we’ll confirm expected ship dates. Refunds for canceled items are issued to the original payment method and currency and may take up to 24 hours once approved; refunds follow the exchange rate from your original payment date and do not include import taxes, duties, or certain shipping charges where applicable. If you want to proceed or have questions, contact customer support (use the same contact method you used to place the order or the site’s customer service channel) to approve a substitution, request cancellation and refund, or get return/return-authorization details for related issues.
source_titles: Do you have a Money Back Guarantee?
